text: 8月31日，江西省委书记尹弘主持召开专题会议，研究大健康产业培育发展工作。他强调，要深入贯彻习近平总书记关于健康中国重要论述，立足资源禀赋与产业基础，聚焦更好满足人民群众对美好生活的向往，发挥独特优势，精准发力突破，积极培育新技术新产品新模式新业态，加快推动大健康产业高质量发展。尹弘认真听取省发展改革委、省工业和信息化厅、省卫生健康委、省文化和旅游厅等关于大健康产业培育发展有关工作情况汇报，就产业发展具体问题与大家深入交流。他指出，推动大健康产业发展，不仅有利于增进人民群众健康福祉，也有利于我省优化产业结构、培育新的经济增长点。要从贯彻落实健康中国战略、
text_en: On Aug 31, Jiangxi Provincial Party Secretary Yin Hong chaired a special meeting to study work on cultivating and developing the health industry. He emphasized the need to thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important expositions on Healthy China, based on resource endowments and industrial foundations, focus on better meeting people's aspirations for a better life, leverage unique advantages, make precise efforts for breakthroughs, actively cultivate new technologies, new products, new models, and new business forms, and accelerate the high-quality development of the health industry. Yin Hong listened carefully to reports from the Provincial Development and Reform Commission, Provincial Department of Industry and Information Technology, Provincial Health Commission, and Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism on the cultivation and development of the health industry, and had in-depth exchanges with attendees on specific industrial development issues. He noted that promoting the development of the health industry is not only conducive to enhancing people's health and well-being, but also to optimizing the province's industrial structure and cultivating new economic growth points.
